name: Charter Oak
storyParas: Charter Oak layers warm materials with quiet detailing: plaster tones, wood accents, and brass moments that age beautifully.
Five bedrooms, five full and two partial baths, and 4,833 sq ft, with outdoor living centered on pool, shade, and gathering spaces.

name: 68th St
storyParas: On a generous Paradise Valley lot, this home pairs contemporary massing with outdoor living at scale: covered patios, pool, and long views toward Camelback.
Five bedrooms, five-and-a-half baths, and 5,214 sq ft support both private family life and large gatherings, with strong indoor–outdoor connection throughout.

name: Desert Cove II
storyParas: Desert Cove II is a desert-contemporary statement: clean lines, generous glazing, and rooms scaled for both family life and hosting.
Six bedrooms, seven-and-a-half baths, and 5,874 sq ft anchor the program with flexible living zones and strong connection to outdoor space.

name: Via Estrella
storyParas: Via Estrella is one of the largest plans in the portfolio: over 6,200 sq ft with layered outdoor living and a strong indoor–outdoor rhythm.
Five bedrooms and six-and-a-half baths support estate-scale entertaining while keeping private suites calm and separate.

name: 68th II
storyParas: 68th II continues the Ella Lee Homes standard for generous room sizes, layered outdoor spaces, and light-filled interiors.
Six bedrooms, six-and-a-half baths, and 5,197 sq ft, scaled for multi-generational living and entertaining.

name: Desert Cove
storyParas: Desert Cove pairs bold contemporary massing with warm interior materials and long views through oversized openings.
Six bedrooms, seven-and-a-half baths, and 5,547 sq ft, built for multi-generational living and large-scale gatherings.

name: Mitchell
storyParas: Mitchell is a refined contemporary residence in Scottsdale: clean architecture, open sightlines, and warm natural light. The design balances simplicity with everyday comfort.

The home offers four bedrooms and three-and-a-half baths across about 3,957 sq ft of total space, with a layout that connects living, dining, and kitchen in one smooth flow. Large windows and modern finishes carry through the plan, and outdoor living extends the home’s usable space.

name: Earll
storyParas: A new-construction modern farmhouse on Earll Drive in the heart of Arcadia, built by Milco Development. Vaulted, 10-foot ceilings; an open great room that opens to the resort backyard through walls of glass; and a chef's kitchen anchored by Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Cove appliances with a fully equipped butler's pantry.

Five en-suite bedrooms and seven baths across 4,650 sq ft on a half-acre lot. Heated pool and spa, a regulation pickleball court, Control4 home automation, and a three-car garage. Sold September 2025 for $3,645,000.

name: Hazelwood
storyParas: Hazelwood sits in the heart of Scottsdale with clean architecture, open sightlines, and natural light throughout. The plan emphasizes simplicity, balance, and a calm, welcoming environment.
Inside, living, dining, and kitchen flow together while bedrooms read as private retreats. Outside, outdoor living extends the home for gatherings and quiet mornings under the Arizona sky.

name: Hazelwood II
storyParas: Hazelwood II is a stunning modern Arcadia farmhouse: high-quality new construction featuring sleek finishes, a functional open floor plan, and pre-wiring for smart-home features. Five ensuite bedrooms, a vaulted ceiling in the great room, and 10′ ceilings throughout the rest of the home.

From the grand foyer, a wall of windows showers the living space with natural light and views of the beautifully landscaped backyard with sparkling pool and heated spa. The chef’s kitchen is built for entertaining: high-end appliances, a spacious butler’s pantry, under-counter lighting, and a massive 10′ island.
amenities: Full bath in every bedroom suite

name: Apache
storyParas: Apache is a contemporary custom build in walkable Old Town Scottsdale, designed for indoor-outdoor living and easy entertaining. Bright, open interiors, oversized glass sliders to the patio, and a chef's kitchen anchored by a quartz island.
Five bedrooms and five baths across 3,527 sq ft on a 6,633 sq ft lot. Sold March 2025 for $2,300,500.

name: 41st
storyParas: 41st offers modern design on a 12,651 sq ft lot with open layouts and natural light in every room.
Four bedrooms, three-and-a-half baths, with 3,326 sq ft livable and 4,606 sq ft total, plus covered patio and three-car-scale garage program.

name: 5th St
storyParas: 5th St is a modern build minutes from Old Town Scottsdale with no HOA, completed in 2022 and sold fully furnished. The open-concept floor plan offers both upstairs and downstairs great rooms, a chef’s kitchen, and a 3-car air-conditioned garage.

Five bedrooms and five baths across 3,934 sq ft, with high-end finishes throughout: hardwood floors, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. An entertainer’s backyard features a built-in BBQ, fire pit, and heated pool.
amenities: Master downstairs with separate shower and tub
Two stories on a 6,562 sq ft lot
Built-in BBQ and gas fire pit

name: Larkspur
storyParas: Larkspur is located in a peaceful and well-established Scottsdale neighborhood, offering modern architecture, open spaces, and abundant natural light that enhances the home from morning to evening. The design focuses on comfort, clarity, and a warm atmosphere that feels inviting the moment you step inside.

The interior layout flows smoothly between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a space that is both functional and relaxing. Large windows brighten the rooms throughout the day, while refined finishes and thoughtful details add a touch of elegance. Each bedroom is designed as a private retreat, offering calm and comfort.
Outside, the home continues its sense of ease with outdoor spaces perfect for gatherings, quiet mornings, or enjoying the surrounding environment.
amenities: 520 sq ft of covered outdoor area
488 sq ft attached, RV gate access

name: 4th St
storyParas: 4th St is designed for everyday ease: open spaces, strong daylight, and a layout that moves naturally from indoors to out. A separate den/office, family room, and bonus room give the home flexibility for how Arizona families actually live.
Five bedrooms, five baths across 4,691 sq ft. Sold January 2024 for $2,100,000.

name: 2nd St
storyParas: 2nd St is a refined modern build in walkable Old Town Scottsdale: a quiet, light-filled floor plan with strong indoor-outdoor flow and warm finishes throughout.
Five bedrooms, four-and-a-half baths across 3,841 sq ft. Sold July 2023 for $1,700,000.

name: Coolidge
storyParas: Coolidge emphasizes comfort and simplicity: open layouts, soft daylight, and refined finishes throughout.
Three bedrooms, three-and-a-half baths, with 4,153 sq ft livable and 5,578 sq ft total.

name: Glenrosa
storyParas: Glenrosa brings clean modern lines and warm finishes to one of Phoenix's most sought-after neighborhoods.
Five bedrooms, six baths across 3,689 sq ft, designed for indoor-outdoor Arizona living.

name: 5th St 2
storyParas: 5th St 2 continues the story of our Scottsdale builds: refined interiors, thoughtful planning, and genuine build quality.
Five bedrooms, four baths across 3,480 sq ft. Sold 2023 for $1,850,000.

name: Cudia City
storyParas: Cudia City is a statement build in the heart of Camelback East: six bedrooms, seven baths, and over 4,200 sq ft of refined living space.

name: Desert Cove
storyParas: Desert Cove is a sweeping desert-modern build in North Scottsdale: six bedrooms, eight baths, and 5,644 sq ft of indoor-outdoor luxury.
Currently for sale at $4,950,000.

name: Camino
storyParas: Camino is our most ambitious Paradise Valley estate: 8,002 sq ft of curated luxury, six bedrooms, eight baths, and careful craftsmanship throughout.
